After she’s done, the Clockwork Soldier enemy will have its turn, followed by Warrior, then Mage, then Thief, etc. This also contributes to a deeper level of strategic gameplay, as you can more effectively plan ahead. 

[b]Omega Burst[/b]

In addition to Personal Skills and Abilities, [i]8-Bit Adventures 2[/i] also features a “Limit Break” mechanic titled Omega Burst. Now, if you’re an RPG veteran, you generally know what this entails – each character has a special, ultimate ability which can be used once a bar fills up. The bar is filled up by the player both dishing out and receiving damage. However, Omega Bursts have one unique difference. Rather than each character having their own unique energy bar to fill up, there is a single bar for the entire party. Once it is filled up, every character has the option to use their Omega Burst; but once a character uses it, the bar is completely emptied. 

I decided to take this approach due to my past experience with other RPGs that implement this mechanic. Sometimes in a game like [i]Final Fantasy VII[/i], the character who’s Limit Break I’d want to use wouldn’t get their bar filled in time, while the other two members of my party would. This new ‘one bar fits all’ approach means that you can choose whose Omega Burst to use and when. And since every character contributes to it, the bar fills up a bit quicker than it would in some other RPGs, meaning that you’ll still get to utilise plenty of these attacks in tough battles. 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8798587/fa61388f6e907bbac7d2e3239bf717c03fe1b648.png[/img]

[b]Augmentations[/b]

Finally, let’s discuss Augmentations. These are special, passive abilities that are able to be equipped to a character – much like Weapons and Armour. Augmentations can be found in treasure chests, like any other piece of equipment, and provide numerous effects that allow you to further customise your characters. This includes things like increasing a particular stat (e.g. HP+10%), granting immunity to certain status ailments, decreasing the amount of AP/MP it costs to use special abilities/magic, imbuing your ordinary attacks with the ability to inflict negative statuses, and much more. 

Each character has 5 Augmentation slots to use (although you only start off with one open slot – more are unlocked as you progress through the game). Additionally, there is a sixth ‘Special’ slot that only fits character-exclusive augmentations. There are two exclusive augmentations for each character, so you’ll have to decide which of them to equip!

[b]Wrapping Up[/b]

Oh, and one last thing I should mention – the Colour Element system from the first game is no longer a mechanic in [i]8-Bit Adventures 2[/i]. I was considering it early on, but to put it simply, I feel like I did everything I could with it the first time around. So no more matching colours, but I think the new systems will have plenty of depth =)

And after all that, we still haven’t talked about things like the tiered-attack system, or one particular character’s unique command and equipment system. But I hope this helps convey that [i]8-Bit Adventures 2’s[/i] combat is going to feature a lot of depth and possibilities for interesting strategies. 

With that said, though, if you’re concerned about the mechanics becoming too complicated this time around, please don’t worry. While there are a lot of systems, most of them are pretty simple in practice and you can choose not to engage with them. But if you’re an RPG veteran like myself, then you’ll likely have a lot of fun trying to form your own strategies and customise the party. 

[h1][b][u]Till Next Time![/u][/b][/h1]

That’s all for now, but there will be plenty of news in the (relatively) near future! I always post [i]8-Bit Adventures 2[/i] updates here on Steam, but [b]I also highly recommend following [/b][url=https://twitter.com/CriticalGamesAU]@CriticalGamesAU[/url][b] on Twitter, as that’s the best way I’ve found to keep up-to-date on news![/b]

You can also check out the [url=http://www.criticalgames.com.au/8-bit-adventures-2.html]Critical Games Website[/url] for more [i]8-Bit Adventures 2[/i] info and screenshots (including some animated GIFs), or check Facebook at: https://www.facebook.com/CriticalGamesDev

Just an aside, if you’ve been following these posts, you may remember that last year I said that [i]8-Bit Adventures 2[/i] would be renamed at some point. However, I’m currently thinking of keeping the name as 8-Bit Adventures 2. It’s short, simple, and straightforward– at least, compared to 8-Bit Adventures: The Forgotten Journey Remastered Edition =P If nothing else, 8-Bit Adventures 2: Adventure Harder and 8-Bit Adventures 2: 8-Bit Boogaloo are definitely out!

Thank you very much for reading, and I hope everyone has a fantastic Summer (or Winter if you’re in the Southern Hemisphere, like myself)! =D

notes.title: 8-Bit Adventures - 2 Year Steam Anniversary Sale!
notes.notes:
Yep, that's right - it's time for another Weeklong Sale! 

But this isn't just any sale - [b]this month marks the 2 year anniversary of my previous game [i]8-Bit Adventures[/i] being released on Steam![/b] And this was a very important turning point for me as a game developer. Because of that release, I've been able to fund and create what is by far the largest and highest quality game that I've ever made - [i]8-Bit Adventures 2[/i].

And it's certainly not just about money! The [i]8-Bit Adventures[/i] player-base honestly blew me away with their patience, their feedback, and frankly their kindness. I felt a genuine sense of community when the game first launched, and I've had the opportunity to speak to a lot of wonderful people. 

So before we get to the business part, [b]I just wanted to say a big THANK YOU[/b] to everyone who's been present on the forum, written a review, sent me a message or email, made a comment somewhere, or just simply played the game. [b]It honestly means a lot to me =)[/b]

...As you can probably tell, my ability to get creative with these discount announcements has greatly diminished over the last couple of years =P But these sales are important, as they not only introduce new people to [i]8-Bit Adventures[/i] and [i]Tales Across Time[/i], but [b]every purchase goes towards funding to the upcoming [i]8-Bit Adventures 2[/i]![/b]

[h1]Weeklong Sale Discounts[/h1]

From 10AM US Pacific Time, [b][i]Tales Across Time[/i] will go on sale,[/b] making an already cheap game even [b]cheaper![/b] At just [b]$2.69 USD[/b], you really can't beat that price; trust me - I set the prices ;)

Additionally, my previous game [b][i]8-Bit Adventures[/i] is 60% off![/b] That means you can own it for just [b]$4 USD![/b] You can also get the [b]fantastic Remastered Soundtrack 30% off ($3.50 USD)[/b], or the [b]Game + Soundtrack bundle 45% off (that’s only $6.60 USD)![/b]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/370300
As I said in February, [b]the discounts won't get any lower[/b] and the Wishlist numbers just keep going up (over 3500 for [i]8-Bit Adventures[/i] and almost 3000 for [i]Tales Across Time[/i]!). So if you've been interested in starting a new adventure, or know a friend who would like the game, then this is the perfect time to jump in!

[h1]Updates and Light Conversation[/h1]

2017 has been a fantastic year for gaming so far, with an already impressive list of great games (between [i]Zelda: Breath of the Wild[/i] and [i]Persona 5[/i], I've been a very happy gamer =D). And [b]I can't wait to add [i]8-Bit Adventures 2[/i] to that list later this year.[/b] I'll be posting an update on the game sometime next month, so please stay tuned!

I always post [i]8-Bit Adventures 2[/i] updates here on Steam, but [b]I also highly recommend following [/b][url=https://twitter.com/CriticalGamesAU]@CriticalGamesAU[/url][b] on Twitter, as that’s the best way I’ve found to keep up-to-date on news![/b] 

I'm also getting into the habit of using Twitter more frequently to comment on games (particularly RPGs and retro games), retweet other indie efforts, and occasionally mention other fun 'geeky' stuff (like [i]Star Wars[/i]). In January, a [i]Final Fantasy IX[/i] picture I tweeted got around 70k impressions, so that was pretty exciting to see so much love for my favourite (and an often forgotten) [i]Final Fantasy[/i]! But I digress =P 

You can also check out the [url=http://www.criticalgames.com.au/8-bit-adventures-2.html]Critical Games Website[/url] for more [i]8-Bit Adventures 2[/i] info and screenshots (including some animated GIFs), or check Facebook at: https://www.facebook.com/CriticalGamesDev

Okay, I think that's enough marketing. Thank you for reading, as always, and to any players, new or old, [b]thank you so much for supporting [i]8-Bit Adventures[/i] these past 2 years.[/b] 

Here's to a bright future! =D

notes.title: Weeklong Sale Discounts + Enemies of 8-Bit Adventures 2 Sneak Peek!
notes.notes:
Hi there! I hope you've all played some great games and been having a fantastic 2017 so far =D If you're looking for something to tide you over until the release of Horizon, Mass Effect, or (my next obsession) Zelda next month, [b]I'm very happy to announce a brand new Weeklong Sale discount![/b] 

In future, I always post future updates here on Steam, but [b]I also highly recommend following [url=https://twitter.com/CriticalGamesAU]@CriticalGamesAU[/url] on Twitter[/b], as that’s the best way I’ve found to keep up-to-date on news!

[h1]Weeklong Sale Discounts[/h1]

From 10AM US Pacific Time, [b][i]Tales Across Time[/i] will go on sale[/b], making an already cheap game even cheaper! At just [b]$2.69 USD[/b], you really can't beat that price; trust me - I set the prices ;)

Additionally, my previous game [b][i]8-Bit Adventures[/i] is 60% off![/b] That means you can own it for [b]just $4 USD![/b] You can also get the [b]fantastic Remastered Soundtrack 30% off ($3.50 USD)[/b], or the [b]Game + Soundtrack bundle 45% off (that’s only $6.60 USD)![/b]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/370300

[b]The discounts won't get any lower[/b] and the Wishlist numbers just keep going up (3500 for 8-Bit Adventures and over 2800 for Tales Across Time!). So if you've been interested in starting a new adventure, or know a friend who would like the game, then this is the perfect time to jump in. Why, you ask? Well, read on!

[h1]Enemies of 8-Bit Adventures 2 Sneak Peak[/h1]

As many of you know, [b][i]8-Bit Adventures 2[/i] is coming this year![/b] It is by far the biggest project I've ever developed; Jerram Fahey (the pixel artist), Carfonu (the composer), and myself are all hard at work on it. And if you haven't seen the recent teaser trailer, please check it out here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lg872qrw8Bk
I'm not planning on revealing much about the game until close to release, however I wanted to give you an example of Jerram's recent handiwork - [b]the enemies of 8-Bit Adventures 2![/b] As with all elements of the presentation, the monster graphics have been [b]dramatically[/b] improved for the sequel. 

[b]For example, here's both the Headless Ghost and Overweight Snake[/b] - first as they appeared in 8-Bit Adventures 1, and then their new designs in 8-Bit Adventures 2. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8798587/4a9026cc58e5af134d18b03ef64778bbeaf2f101.png[/img] [img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8798587/ee7c03e2dfeac5669538c1cb3cbe6e6458415d7d.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8798587/806c0ba2d85a2b6ed5b12cb1083e2a9dd22807ff.png[/img]            [img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8798587/39c926e4653886292889fc4822be690666efda28.png[/img]

As you can see, it's like night and day! But I should note, [b]there are only 4 returning enemies from the first game[/b] - the rest are brand new. There's a lot I can't show due to spoilers, but I wanted to introduce you to a few new enemies. 

[b]First up is Self-Obsessed Squid.[/b] This is an enemy who has two hobbies - going to the Gym and staring at itself the mirror. Some people call it self-obsessed, but it doesn't care - just look at those abs! 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8798587/14d635b4cbd1d8491f3e8417e91ec601e2bc0dc6.png[/img]

[b]Next we have the Rattling Ravager[/b] - a fearsome foe reanimated from animal bones. It makes an unpleasant rattling sound whenever it's about to launch an attack. This is actually the first enemy you encounter in the game!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8798587/910acf4f1b4ccef0c9702f8c779e492a7b64cafa.png[/img]

[b]CRUSH!! is a big rock.[/b] He likes to crush things. Particularly player characters. If CRUSH!! had to describe himself, CRUSH!! might say that he’s the illegitimate love child of a Thwomp from Mario and a Rockbomb from Dragon Quest. But that's assuming CRUSH!! could talk...which he can't. Makes you wonder why he has a mouth, really. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8798587/45e4871f945f56b086beb8c10de199c00cd8362a.png[/img]

[b]And last but not least, we have the Clockwork Controller[/b] - a boss enemy. Without giving much away, let's just say that this foe comes from a very different place than the rest of these enemies. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8798587/7ea55535dce20691e38fe3779245e5b5d4fda470.png[/img]

[h1]'Till Next Time![/h1]

I hope that everyone enjoyed this quick look at the enemies of [i]8-Bit Adventures 2[/i] - [b]there's plenty more to come throughout the year![/b] 

And as always, I’ll post future updates here on Steam, but [b]I also highly recommend following [url=https://twitter.com/CriticalGamesAU]@CriticalGamesAU[/url] on Twitter[/b], as that’s the best way I’ve found to keep up-to-date on news!

I sincerely appreciate your continued patience and support, and as always [b]I hope that this Weeklong Sale allows even more players to enjoy [i]8-Bit Adventures[/i] and [i]Tales Across Time[/i]![/b]

notes.title: Winter Sale Deals + End of 2016 Message!
notes.notes:
[b]Happy Holidays everyone![/b]

[h1][b][u]Winter Sale[/u][/b][/h1]

It’s just three sleeps ‘till Christmas, so you know what that means – it’s time for the Steam Winter Sale!

To be honest, I’ve always found the timing of the Winter Sale so close to Christmas a bit strange; but there are some fantastic deals to be found! So while I heartily recommend spending this festive time with family and friends, there’s no harm in picking up some last minute Christmas presents...or early New Year's treats ;) 

So what do I have in my bag of deals? Well, this Holiday Season my most recent game [b][i]Tales Across Time[/i] is also participating in the sale[/b], making an already cheap game even cheaper! At [b]just $2.69 USD[/b], you really can't beat that price (literally - take it from the guy who sets the price!) ;)

And that’s not all! My previous game [b][i]8-Bit Adventures[/i] is also participating in the sale at 60% off![/b] That means you can own it for [b]just $4 USD![/b] You can also get the [b]fantastic Remastered Soundtrack 30% off ($3.50 USD)[/b], or the [b]Game + Soundtrack bundle 45% off (that’s only $6.60 USD)![/b]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/370300

[h1][b][u]8-Bit Adventures 2[/u][/b][/h1]

If you haven’t seen it yet, I also recommend checking out the [b][i]8-Bit Adventures 2[/i] Teaser Trailer![/b] Just click the image below:

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lg872qrw8Bk][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8798587/e7a01c301835b0f60c01fcd20e81c9e922577f76.png[/img][/url]

And if you want to keep up with future 8-Bit Adventures 2 updates as they happen, [b]please follow @CriticalGamesAU on Twitter! [/b]

[h1][b][u]End of 2016 Message[/u][/b]

2016 has been a pretty difficult year for…well, everyone - and in quite a variety of ways. So to close out the year, I want to leave you with a quote from the great Hironobu Sakaguchi, creator of Final Fantasy. In a recent interview with [url=http://www.glixel.com/interviews/final-fantasy-creator-sakaguchi-on-remakes-xv-and-square-w452889]Glixel[/url], he said: 

[quote=Hironobu Sakaguchi]“I like making games that make you feel hopeful for the future, striving for a better tomorrow.”[/quote]

While I can’t hold a candle to Mr Sakaguchi’s skill as a Game Designer, this statement encapsulates how I try to approach my own games. When you think about it, most RPG narratives can be described as hope and love overcoming cynicism and nihilism; and that’s a message I think we can all appreciate after the trials of 2016. 

[b]So I promise to do my best to provide a game which inspires a sense of fun, hope, and joy in 2017! Thank you so much for your support and I hope to see you next year =D[/b][/h1]

So while I heartily recommend spending this festive time with family and friends, there’s no harm in picking up some last minute Christmas presents...or early New Year's treats ;) 

So what do I have in my bag of deals? Well, this Holiday Season my most recent game [b][i]Tales Across Time[/i] is also participating in the sale[/b], making an already cheap game even cheaper! At [b]just $2.69 USD[/b], you really can't beat that price (literally - take it from the guy who sets the price!) ;)

And that’s not all! My previous game [b][i]8-Bit Adventures[/i] is also participating in the sale at 60% off![/b] That means you can own it for [b]just $4 USD![/b] You can also get the [b]fantastic Remastered Soundtrack 30% off ($3.50 USD)[/b], or the [b]Game + Soundtrack bundle 45% off (that’s only $6.60 USD)![/b]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/370300

[h1][b][u]8-Bit Adventures 2[/u][/b][/h1]

If you haven’t seen it yet, I also recommend checking out the [b][i]8-Bit Adventures 2[/i] Teaser Trailer![/b] Just click the image below:

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=lg872qrw8Bk][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8798587/e7a01c301835b0f60c01fcd20e81c9e922577f76.png[/img][/url]

And if you want to keep up with future 8-Bit Adventures 2 updates as they happen, [b]please follow @CriticalGamesAU on Twitter! [/b]

[h1][b][u]End of 2016 Message[/u][/b]

2016 has been a pretty difficult year for…well, everyone - and in quite a variety of ways. So to close out the year, I want to leave you with a quote from the great Hironobu Sakaguchi, creator of Final Fantasy. In a recent interview with [url=http://www.glixel.com/interviews/final-fantasy-creator-sakaguchi-on-remakes-xv-and-square-w452889]Glixel[/url], he said: 

[quote=Hironobu Sakaguchi]“I like making games that make you feel hopeful for the future, striving for a better tomorrow.”[/quote]

While I can’t hold a candle to Mr Sakaguchi’s skill as a Game Designer, this statement encapsulates how I try to approach my own games. When you think about it, most RPG narratives can be described as hope and love overcoming cynicism and nihilism; and that’s a message I think we can all appreciate after the trials of 2016. 

[b]So I promise to do my best to provide a game which inspires a sense of fun, hope, and joy in 2017! Thank you so much for your support and I hope to see you next year =D[/b][/h1]

notes.notes:
[b]Happy Holidays everyone![/b] I’ve got some exciting news this festive month of December, so let’s get right to it.

Throughout December, the massively popular [b]Yogscast are running their annual Jingle Jam Bundle for charity[/b], and [b][i]Tales Across Time[/i] is participating![/b] New games will be revealed every day, and [b]every cent goes directly to charities[/b] chosen by the Yogscast community. So support a great cause and pick up 37 great games!

https://www.humblebundle.com/yogscast-jingle-jam 

But that’s not all! The Yogscast crew are streaming all throughout December, and not only will they be playing a little bit of [i]Tales Across Time[/i], but they’ll be [b]streaming the first ever look at the 8-Bit Adventures 2 Teaser Trailer![/b]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8798587/e7a01c301835b0f60c01fcd20e81c9e922577f76.png[/img]

The trailer will go live on Youtube afterwards (I highly recommend watching in 1080p), as well as the [i]8-Bit Adventures 2[/i] page on www.criticalgames.com.au. The game is still quite a way off release, but [b]I sincerely hope you all enjoy the trailer[/b] – I put a lot of work into it =) 

So please [b]check out the Yogscast Jingle Jam 2016 Bundle, support charity, enjoy some great games, and check out the new trailer![/b] And if possible, please [b]share the bundle on social media[/b] – let’s do our part to get the word out there as much as possible! 

I believe the trailer will be shown on the [b]17th of December[/b], but this is always subject to change, so please [b]check the Steam page and @CriticalGamesAU on Twitter to stay up to date[/b] – I’ll post updates as soon as I have any news to share.

[b]Thank you all so much for your support in 2016.[/b] I can’t wait for you all to see the trailer, and 2017 is going to be a massive year with the launch of 8-Bit Adventures 2 – I promise that it won’t become the next Final Fantasy Versus XIII/XV ;) 

...Although, real talk? I can’t wait to play that game! I’m excited about Final Fantasy for the first time in years, and I can’t think of a better way to close out 2016 for RPG fans like myself =D 

[b]Have a fantastic December everyone![/b]

notes.title: Weeklong Sale Discounts + 8-Bit Adventures 2 Interview with Retrogamesmaster!
notes.notes:
G'day! I hope everyone's doing great =D It's been a little while since my last post, so I just wanted to provide a small update. 

[h1]Retrogamesmaster Interview[/h1]

First off, I was [b]interviewed by the fantastic retrogamesmaster.co.uk![/b] We discussed [i]8-Bit Adventures 2[/i], how I got into development, favourite and least favourite games, and much more! I had a great time responding to the questions and I sincerely appreciate their asking me to participate, so I hope it's an enjoyable read! 

http://www.retrogamesmaster.co.uk/8-bit-adventures-2/

[h1]Weeklong Sale - 12th September[/h1]

Next up, I think it's well and truly time for another Weeklong Sale! From 10AM US Pacific Time, you can get [b][i]Tales Across Time[/i] at 10% off,[/b] making an already cheap game even cheaper! At just [b]$2.69 USD[/b], you really can't beat that price ;)

Additionally, my previous game [b][i]8-Bit Adventures[/i] is 60% off![/b] That means you can own it for [b]just $4 USD![/b] You can also get the [b]fantastic Remastered Soundtrack 30% off ($3.50 USD)[/b], or the [b]Game + Soundtrack bundle 45% off (that’s only $6.60 USD)![/b]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/370300

Well over 2000 people have [i]Tales Across Time[/i] on their Wishlist, and over 3000 still want [i]8-Bit Adventures[/i]! [b]The discounts won't get any lower[/b] - at least not for a very long time - so if you're interested, this week is a perfect opportunity to [b]pick up some RPG action AND contribute to the development of [i]8-Bit Adventures 2[/i]![/b] Speaking of which...

[h1]8-Bit Adventures 2 Progress Report[/h1]

[b]Development of [i]8-Bit Adventures 2[/i] is progressing well[/b] - still a long way to go, sadly, but I'm really happy with the way it's turning out! Most of my time at the moment is spent constructing the environments, and I can safely say that this is going to be a much more diverse and varied adventure than the last. 

Beyond that, the artist (Jerram Fahey) has been doing an incredible job creating the graphics for said environments, as well as the various NPCs (who will also be much more diverse). Even though I ask for specific assets, he always manages to surprise me, so I really can't wait to show you all more of his work! 

And the composer (Carfonu) has already produced some fantastic, catchy tunes that I can't get out of my head (the Coastal Town, which you can see a screenshot of in the previous update, is a particular favourite of mine)! 

[h1]That's All Folks![/h1]

As always, I’ll post future updates here on Steam, but I also highly recommend following [url=https://twitter.com/CriticalGamesAU]@CriticalGamesAU[/url] on Twitter, as that’s the best way I’ve found to keep up-to-date on news! 

I sincerely appreciate your continued patience and support, and I hope this Weeklong Sale allows even more players to enjoy [i]8-Bit Adventures[/i] and [i]Tales Across Time[/i]!

But enough of my groaning, let’s get to the point - [b][i]Tales Across Time[/i] is making its discount début,[/b] turning an already cheap game even cheaper! At [b]$2.69 USD[/b], it’s a steal ;)

Additionally, my previous game [b][i]8-Bit Adventures[/i] is 60% off![/b] That means you can own it for [b]just $4 USD![/b] You can also get the [b]fantastic Remastered Soundtrack 30% off ($3.50 USD)[/b], or the [b]Game + Soundtrack bundle 45% off (that’s only $6.60 USD)![/b] 

But these great deals only last until the end of the Summer Sale (11 days), so get in quick!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/370300
Now, as you probably saw in the title, I also have something very special for fans – [b]your first glimpse at [i]8-Bit Adventures 2[/i]![/b] Now, I say first glimpse because everything is still very early and this is a big project. But as I’ve been making everyone wait so long, I really wanted to put something out there =) Also, please note that the game will not be called '8-Bit Adventures 2' – it’s just a working title (I'll try to have something better next time!). 

But, without further adieu, here’s your first look at the game:

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8798587/87e1241237ee27521e010500f6d1f3f57232df86.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8798587/7bcc5364925df3bc6dd07126a5049f8ed1a48c5e.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8798587/2fe016657f7ef0c70a2cb24829444380febb1960.png[/img]

Not only can you see that [i]8-Bit Adventures 2[/i] will feature plenty of new environments, but you probably also noticed a new player character! I won’t say much about him, but he’s one of the six main party members in the game. And if you played [i]8-Bit Adventures 1[/i], you’ve most likely met him before ;)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8798587/7bce90c24906743eaf26c7e957f15a12fc06c846.png[/img]

But, of course, there are also plenty of returning characters and environments! I’m really trying to find a balance between old and new locations, but even returning areas will look [b]significantly[/b] improved. And most have been heavily redesigned (albeit with a few nods to their original form).

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8798587/666baaeceddea69a73b3ee5dbf870c9995e68aa7.png[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8798587/d4134dce6637f9403541f4532b0c2f65040afca1.png[/img]

Speaking of which, above you can see a screenshot comparison of a map from the new Red Mage Tower compared to the same location in [i]8-Bit Adventures 1[/i]. Not only has Thief has had a great redesign, but you can also see that the graphics are worlds apart, despite sticking to the same 8-Bit aesthetic.

And that’s because this time around, the graphics are being created by a professional sprite artist, Jerram Fahey. He made the character graphics for [i]8-Bit Adventures 1[/i], but at the time I didn’t have enough money to hire him to create other assets.  

Thanks to the sales of [i]8-Bit Adventures[/i] and [i]Tales Across Time[/i], my funding situation has improved – and I’m pouring almost all of the money I’ve earned from those games into this project. So by purchasing my games, you’re directly funding [i]8-Bit Adventures 2[/i]; for which I have to say a big thank you in advance! =D

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8798587/d458124120e80af99a42f055e9a0b01afec129bb.png[/img]

And finally, what’s an 8-Bit inspired RPG without a World Map? While this screenshot probably looks quite familiar (I don’t want to show off much just yet), I can say that the world has seen some massive changes. Hopefully those changes are something that fans of the first game will really enjoy discovering!

Now I know it's not a lot, but I hope that gives fans something to look forward to. I’ll post future updates here on Steam, but I also highly recommend following [url=https://twitter.com/CriticalGamesAU]@CriticalGamesAU[/url] on Twitter, as that’s the best way I’ve found to keep up-to-date on news! 

Additionally, as was described on the [i]Tales Across Time[/i] Greenlight page back in February, I am still planning to provide an ‘early look’ demo of [i]8-Bit Adventures 2[/i] to players of [i]Tales Across Time[/i] on Steam; as a special thank you for fans who keep up with all of Critical Games releases. Stay tuned for information in the coming months, but at the moment, I’m just completely focused on development.

Thank you all so much for your support, and I hope this year's Summer Sale gives even more players the chance to start a new adventure! =D

notes.title: TALES ACROSS TIME Released on Steam!
notes.notes:
It's here! [i]Tales Across Time[/i] is finally available on Steam for $2.99 USD!

http://store.steampowered.com/app/461710
It's been a long road - the transition from contest entry to fully-fledged game took a lot of work, but I am so grateful to everyone who helped [i]Tales Across Time[/i] get Greenlit. This simply wouldn't be possible without your support! =D

As always, if you have any questions or issues with the game, please let me know via the Community Forum or via email at: criticalgames@tpg.com.au

And if you'd like to learn a bit more about [i]Tales Across Time[/i], I recommend checking out a short series of articles I wrote about the game:

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/updates/630959133/1460025408]#1 - Humble Beginnings[/url]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/updates/630959133/1460025757]#2 - A Story for the Ages[/url]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/updates/630959133/1460421873]#3 - Places to See, Monsters to Fight [/url]

To celebrate, for the first time, my previous game [i]8-Bit Adventures[/i] is 60% off! That means you can own it for just $4 USD! There are other great deals too - this week only - so find out more here:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/370300
I’m really excited for players to get their hands on [i]Tales Across Time[/i]. While it’s a very different style of game to [i]8-Bit Adventures[/i], I think it’s got a lot of the same charm. 

At the end of the day, I develop games because I want to make people happy. The response to [i]8-Bit Adventures[/i] was absolutely incredible, and I really felt like I achieved that goal. So I sincerely hope that everyone enjoys [i]Tales Across Time[/i]!

Thank you all SO much for your patience and support. Have fun! =D
